limits: The full1858-test suite was executed once in this stage; orchestration reuses its exact same-stage TRX only after matching all code, test, fixture and embedded data inputs plus Core DLL.

Only newly opted-in directive originals are physically retained; old originals never gain retroactive papers. Initial lost receipt remains immutable; real late handover, original/copy arrival orders, one canonical effect and actual held-ack recovery are verified. Per-directive cancellation remains the next slice.

Only these27 GPU processes were rerun: four held-directive/late-ack cases, old superseded-root retry, old held-standing-recall retry, wing reply recovery, group/historical entry, legacy military/combat, ground material and three smokes. Other GPU scenarios were not rerun.
80m perception,120m local exercise range and600second default original receipt deadline remain trial coefficients, not nationwide acceptance.
12second fixed60fps recording contains actual person movement leaving the fixed late-ack destination plus chronological saved-state cuts, not a real-time performance benchmark.

visual_review.method: Direct inspection with view_image of five full-size current actual Godot screenshots and five decoded video frames; no mouse automation.

Decoded 2/4/6/9/11 second video frames show chronological holding, handoff, personal movement away from the fixed acknowledgment address, return and actual paper recovery.
Existing overlaid nearby troop labels and a long upper military status row remain crowded; this is command lifecycle acceptance, not final UI readability or background-quality acceptance.
